== Summary ==
Identified: [[Kevin Jaap]] (grey striped hoodie, bald, glasses, and a beard; same face as [[:File:2025 European Championship team event 5.jpg]] and [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg]]) and [[Tamás Papp]] (teal crest-animal shirt; same face and shirt as [[:File:2025 European Championship 15.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled, including the seated player in a dark graphic tee, the player in a cap and patterned shorts, and the player in a brown "MAN the GUNS!" tee (same person as [[:File:2025 European Championship 23.jpg]]).


Players gathered in the hall at the [[2025 European Championship]] at Zu den Vier Winden in Bochum (19–21 September 2025).

* '''Event:''' [[2025 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2025-09-26
* '''Identification:''' [[Kevin Jaap]] (grey striped hoodie, bald, glasses, and a beard; same face as [[:File:2025 European Championship team event 5.jpg]] and [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg]]) and [[Tamás Papp]] (teal crest-animal shirt; same face and shirt as [[:File:2025 European Championship 15.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled, including the seated player in a dark graphic tee, the player in a cap and patterned shorts, and the player in a brown "MAN the GUNS!" tee (same person as [[:File:2025 European Championship 23.jpg]]).
